schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Node is pinned in mise.toml and in the root engines field; bump both together.
pnpm is pinned in mise.toml and in packageManager; bump both together.
The Mantine MCP server is pinned to the Mantine version the UI uses.
The spikes are throwaway probes outside the workspace; they keep their own ranges.

The e2e job's container image ships the browsers of one Playwright version. This group moves it with @playwright/test on a major bump only: the later non-major rule renames the group for minor, patch and digest updates, and its weekly PR carries both. tests/repo/src/ci.test.ts fails a split. After the GitHub Actions rule, which also matches the image.
CODEX_VERIFIED_ON is the Codex release 10db's Codex lanes are verified on. Its bump is a PR of its own, because only the live test, which CI never runs, can verify it.
prBodyNotes: Before merging: install this Codex (`brew upgrade --cask codex`), then run `TENDB_LIVE_CODEX=1 pnpm --filter @10db/daemon exec vitest run test/codex.live.test.ts`. It must pass; CI never runs it.

packageRules.description: Every update that isn't a major version lands in one weekly PR, except Codex's, which needs the live test.
A major version opens a PR only after its box is ticked on the Dependency Dashboard.

customManagers.description: The Codex version 10db's Codex lanes are verified on, read from npm, where Codex is released first.
